items.text: Self-reported score: mean per-gene Pearson r = 0.1229 (SD 0.0004 over 2 splits), on 1500 genes; 900 distinct validation cells enter the gene-level tests.

Required comparators on the same training and validation cells, genes and scoring target: noise ceiling (RNA-to-RNA) 0.1675; cluster-mean baseline 0.1217, ridge 0.1365, partial least squares 0.1376, k-nearest neighbours 0.0687, gene activity 0.0348, depth only 0.0315. The plan reaches 73% of the ceiling.
Margin over the cluster-mean baseline: mean per-gene difference in r = +0.0015 (95% interval +0.0010 to +0.0020, bootstrap over cells); margin over the best simple learner (ridge, PLS, k-NN) -0.0147.

Three-way gene classification by the evaluator's rule, applied inside the development set: 389 genes cannot be judged (ceiling not above the permutation null), 1070 are not beyond the cell-type baseline, 41 are predicted beyond cell type (paired bootstrap against the cluster-mean baseline, FDR 5%; 3.7% of judgeable genes). Genes with r above the permutation null: 898.

Training: fit 0: early_stopping after 17 epochs, converged=True (Base: cluster mean (k 20). One boosted model per gene on the residual, early stopping on an internal 12% split; 99.8% of 1500 fitted genes stopped before the cap of 150 iterations (median 17 iterations).); fit 1: early_stopping after 17 epochs, converged=True (Base: cluster mean (k 20). One boosted model per gene on the residual, early stopping on an internal 12% split; 100.0% of 1500 fitted genes stopped before the cap of 150 iterations (median 17 iterations).).

Validation design: split unit cell; a single hold-out of 30%; 3 seed(s); scored against an independent half of each validation cell's reads (unsmoothed, same as the evaluator). Early stopping used a separate split carved from the training cells.
Scale of this run: pilot; 2 of the 3 declared train/validation splits were run (3000 development cells, 1500 genes; the full problem has 7288 cells and 11282 genes).
Cost: 40 s of model fitting on 32 CPU cores (cpu); declared budget for the full run 85.0 min, needs GPU: False.
